store.summary: Pre-flight checklist and LiPo battery calculator for FPV drone pilots
store.description: Pocket companion for FPV flying. Three checklists - Bench (before leaving home), Field (before takeoff) and Post-flight - with progress per list, saved between launches. The LiPo calculator shows per-cell voltage, estimated charge, battery status (full / storage / land now) and expected flight time from pack size and average current. Works fully offline, keyboard only: F/X to move, Enter to check, Z/C to switch lists.
